source.note: 2001 Leaf Rookies & Stars Baseball hobby product. The 300-card flagship checklist and full 300-card Longevity parallel are each kept intact as single VCS ProductSets for completion tracking. Chicago Sun-Times Collection and Beckett sample issues are excluded because they were not ordinary hobby-pack outcomes.

decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: Base #1-300 remains one VCS Base ProductSet. Historically #101-200 were inserted 1:4 packs and #201-300 at 1:24; VCS intentionally flattens those range-specific odds so completion percentage reflects the full 300-card set.
decisions.longevityModeling: Longevity #1-300 remains one full parallel ProductSet. Cards #1-100 are SN50 and #101-300 are SN25; serial tiers are retained per card while the checklist is not split.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: True RC status is taken from the set's recognized rookie-card index. Only those base cards get RC appended to Player. Rookie-themed or short-printed cards that are not recognized true RCs do not.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the clean card subject name plus verified RC when applicable. UER/ERR/COR, MEM, AU, SP, PR/SN and other collector annotations stay in metadata.
decisions.oddsPlacement: Insertion odds are stored only on ProductSets. No per-card Variant field receives text such as 'Inserted 1:96 packs'.
decisions.hitModeling: Known set-specific hobby odds are encoded where directly published. Other autograph, memorabilia and serial-only families remain oddsPerPack null rather than inventing rates from stated print runs or the broad one-GU/AU-per-box guarantee.
decisions.excludedRelatedSets: Chicago Sun-Times Collection, Beckett Samples Gold and Beckett Samples Silver are excluded from this hobby Product because they are event/sample issues rather than ordinary pack pulls.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until images and pricing are reviewed.
